# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 2 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 7 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #ffffff | #1c1c1e | Cards, panels, inputs, quiz options and any raised container on bg. |
| `surface-sunken` | #ececf0 | #2c2c2e | Progress tracks, table headers, code chips and other wells set into surface or bg. Do not put ink-muted text on it. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--ink);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ink` | #1d1d1f | #f5f5f7 | Primary text on bg, surface and surface-sunken. |
| `ink-muted` | #68686d | #a1a1a6 | Secondary text such as meta lines, dates and captions, on bg and surface only (4.3:1 on surface-sunken in Light, so never there). |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--on-accent);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `on-accent` | #ffffff | #00162b | Text and icons on accent fills (4.7:1 Light, 6.1:1 Dark). |
| `accent-text` | #0066cc | #2997ff | Links, ghost buttons and accent-colored text on bg, surface and accent-soft (4.8:1 or better in both themes). |
| `accent-soft` | #e6f0fc | #0b2a4a | Tint behind selected items, info badges and the join code. Text on it is accent-text. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--bg);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg` | #f5f5f7 | #000000 | Page background behind every view. Cards sit on it as surface. |
| `line` | #d2d2d7 | #3a3a3c | Decorative hairlines: card borders, row dividers. Never the only cue that a control exists. |
| `line-strong` | #86868b | #8e8e93 | Borders that identify a control (inputs, secondary buttons, quiz options). At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes. |
| `accent` | #0071e3 | #2997ff | Primary action fills, progress bars, avatars and the focus ring. Text on it is on-accent. |
| `success` | #1a7f37 | #30d158 | Correct answers and completed states, on bg and surface. Always paired with a word such as Correct or Complete. |
| `warning` | #8f5200 | #ff9f0a | Overdue and attention states, on bg and surface. Always paired with a word such as Overdue. |
| `danger` | #d70015 | #ff453a | Wrong answers, destructive actions and errors, on bg and surface. Always paired with a word or mark. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-large-title);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `large-title` | `.large-title`, `--text-large-title` | 34px / 41px | 700 | `sans` | One per page: the class or course name. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 28px / 34px | 700 | `sans` | Section titles on a page. |
| `headline` | `.headline`, `--text-headline` | 20px / 25px | 600 | `sans` | Card titles and module headings. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Module explanations and running text. |
| `callout` | `.callout`, `--text-callout` | 15px / 22px | 400 | `sans` | Quiz questions, options and announcement text. |
| `subhead` | `.subhead`, `--text-subhead` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Meta lines under titles, table cells. |
| `footnote` | `.footnote`, `--text-footnote` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` | Hints and helper text. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 12px / 16px | 400 | `sans` | Dates and small labels. |
| `eyebrow` | `.eyebrow`, `--text-eyebrow` | 12px / 16px | 600 | `sans` | Uppercase labels above a heading. |
| `code` | `.code`, `--text-code` | 13px / 20px | 400 | `mono` | Inline code and identifiers. |
| `join-code` | `.join-code`, `--text-join-code` | 22px / 28px | 700 | `mono` | The five-character class join code. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Roboto, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Tight gaps inside a note or badge. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Gap between an icon or avatar and its label. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Gap between stacked items in a card; option padding. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Page side gutter minimum; gap between cards. |
| `space-5` | 20px | Card padding; button side padding. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Gap between page sections inside a card group. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Gap between page sections. |
| `space-12` | 48px | Top-level section spacing and hero padding. |

## Radius

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 8px | Small chips and code tags. |
| `radius-md` | 12px | Buttons, inputs, quiz options, join code, announcements. |
| `radius-lg` | 20px | Cards and panels. |
| `radius-pill` | 999px | Badges, progress bars and avatars. |

## Shadow

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-card) */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-card` | 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.06) · dark: none | Cards at rest in Light. Dark uses the line border instead. |
